_pullQuote: Added 2026-08-19: 20 reviews on the Stryker and no quote on the page. John L.L.'s own title and words, verbatim from the lgh01 pull. Five stars.

pullQuote.title: Best club in my bag
pullQuote.quote: Played 2 rounds and love swinging and hitting a fairway shot. Best club in my bag now

buyBody: Nineteen degrees of titanium for the 210-yard shot your long irons keep missing. Gets up easy, stays fast off the heel and toe, and it's gold, which you will hear about. Right or left hand.
whatYouGet: One Stryker LGH01 hybrid in the hand you picked
No headcover (none of our clubs ship with one)
clubHeadline: The club that makes 210 yards a normal shot.
clubParas: There's a club at the top of your bag you reach for and then put back. This replaces it. Nineteen degrees of titanium, light at 235 grams, so it gets the ball up from the lies a long iron makes you fight. The Flex Channel face keeps the ball speed up on the strikes you don't catch in the middle, and the Glide Sole moves through fairway and rough the same way. Stiff graphite, right or left hand, and 210 yards stops being a shot you think about.

clubSpecs.v: Easy launch from a compact head, and ball speed that holds up on the strikes you don't center.
Titanium head at 235 g with a Flex Channel face and a Glide Sole. Brushed gold face, mirror gold sole, gloss black crown with a gold starburst. Stiff graphite, 40.5 inches.
Anyone whose long irons have stopped being trustworthy.

videoBrief: 16:9 product film, 40–60s. The pitch is a distance, so film the distance: 210 yards from the fairway, ball tracked to the green, then the same shot struck off the toe to show what forgiveness actually means.
specHeadline: Nineteen degrees and not much else to pick
specSub: One loft, one flex, one length. The sheet is short because the decision is.

head.v: Brushed satin gold face, mirror gold sole, gloss black crown with a gold starburst, gold ferrule

specTabs.caption: Stryker LGH01 · Lucky graphite

head.v: Fitted as standard. Stiff is the only flex.

specTabs.aside: Stiff is the only flex it comes in. The wedges and putters ship Regular.

look.photo: Bold, full-bleed, portrait. Gold titanium head on the fairway at address, low sun. A hybrid is a wide, shallow shape. Shoot it from behind so the width reads as confidence rather than bulk.
look.headline: The club you stop worrying about
paras: There is a specific relief in standing over a 210-yard shot and not running the numbers on whether you can actually hit the club in your hands.
In gold, with a gloss black crown and a starburst on it, it doesn't look like anyone else's hybrid either.

closeBody: Take the club you don't trust out of the bag and put this in. Right or left hand.

bag.name: Carver 01 Gold
bag.hook: The wedge most people add first. Six lofts, same feel.

bag.name: Carver 01 Black
bag.hook: The blacked-out wedge. Same K Grind, same 1020 forged steel.

helpPick.headline: It goes in the bag where something else comes out
helpPick.sub: Two ways to use it. Most golfers take out the 3-iron. Some take out the 5-wood. Here's how each one goes.

options.name: Instead of a 3-iron
options.body: A 3-iron and a 19° hybrid go roughly the same distance in the right hands. The difference is what happens in the wrong ones. The hybrid gets airborne from lies where the iron simply does not.

options.name: Instead of a 5-wood
options.forWho: The club you can't keep straight
options.body: A 5-wood and a 19° hybrid cover similar ground, and the hybrid is the shorter club at 40.5″. That is why it is easier to find the middle of, and why it holds a line off a tight tee.

helpPick.note: Either way it is one club, one loft and one flex, in right or left hand. If the gap between your longest iron and your fairway wood is a real one, this is a straightforward decision.

_specsource: helpPick facts are v1.8 only. The previous rows claimed a 200-220 yd carry and two comparative performance advantages; none of that is in the reference guide and the carry came off the retired Shopify description.
_club: Fourth pass, 2026-08-19. Cole: 'I feel like you're using the same structure over and over again.' He was right: every intro opened material -> 'so it feels' -> feature -> 'so it' -> spec line. Takomo's intros each open through a different door (a situation, a joke, a problem, a brag, a sibling). THIS ONE OPENS WITH: the club you keep putting back.
_specTabs: Takomo-shaped 2026-08-19 to match the other four clubs: three cards, caption, stacked head, black-header matrix. One loft, so the figures run as columns against one loft row. Every number is the guide's LGH01 table and shaft/grip line.
_closeBody: 'In a run of a hundred' came off 2026-08-19. HANDOFF 15a recorded the LGH01 as no longer a limited run and the 100-units claim as removed; this line had survived it.
